segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the serum absorbs quickly without leaving a greasy feel, and one long-term user says it reduced her oiliness over time, though one reviewer switching from a discontinued Origins serum found it made her oily skin worse.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe the serum as hydrating and say it improved dry, bumpy, or flaky patches, but two others report it left their skin drier, flaky, or burning.
segments.combination: A combination-skin reviewer says it absorbed well with no oily residue, unlike some other serums she tried.
segments.sensitive: Most self-described sensitive-skin reviewers report no irritation and good tolerance including under eyes, but several others with sensitive skin describe rashes, burning, itchy bumps, or an allergic reaction.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 50s-70s report firmer, more even, glowing skin and reduced fine lines with continued use.
segments.normal: A normal/dry-leaning reviewer says the serum keeps her face fresh with no complaints.

concerns.aging: Reviewers describe plumper skin, reduced fine lines around the eyes, and firmer, smoother maturing skin; no dissent noted for this concern specifically.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers report smoother, more hydrated skin and disappearance of dry patches, but a few describe increased dryness, flakiness, or a need to follow up with extra moisturizer.
concerns.redness: A minority of reviewers report redness, itchy bumps, or burn-like irritation, in some cases requiring topical steroids, while most others report no redness at all.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer describes burning and irritation nearly everywhere except her nose, and another reports her skin became more sensitive overall, though most reviewers report the product as gentle.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report faded acne scars, sun marks, and discoloration evening out with continued use.
concerns.blemishes: Several long-time Origins users report new breakouts, bumps, or cystic-feeling pimples after starting the serum, sometimes lasting weeks, while other acne-prone reviewers report clearer skin and fewer breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: Several reviewers say the serum does not leave an oily film and even reduces oiliness over time, while one reviewer switching from a discontinued formula says it made her oily skin worse.

extraits.titre: Left my skin bumpy and with breakouts
extraits.texte: I do not recommend this product. After just one application, within a day I noticed that my face was bumpy and I had breakouts (Prior to using this, I had not had any breakouts in years). It took 10 days for my skin to return to normal with no bumps. I do not typically have sensitive skin but some ingredient in this product is not compatible with me.

I really wanted to continue to love this product. But! I was breaking out! I had read previous reviews about this issues and hoped it wouldn't happen to me. But process of elimination and I just stopped using it after 4 months. It's been about two weeks and my face has almost gone back to normal. I noticed results within a week. Now, I am 42 and have had acne back in the day but not to this extent recently. However, I did like the way it felt on my face! It wasn't greasy and it did give me a glow along with shrinking my pores which really drew me to the product in the first place. Overall good product but I can no longer use it. Oh well.

I've been really pleased with this product! I use it at night only, but even with just one time a day use, I've noticed a difference in my skin. It has been quite a bit smoother and noticeably more hydrated, which contributes to overall brighter looking skin. I have slightly dry skin around my nose and it's been that way for years regardless of what products I use. The only time it went away is when I used a face scrub, followed by a hydrating mask, and even then, it only disappeared for a day or two. However, since using this product, I no longer have the dry patches of skin at all, and I haven't needed to use a face scrub in general because my skin is so smooth. I'm attributing this to the AHA/BHA complex and green coffee seed extract. This product has overall been really awesome!

extraits.titre: It convinced a friend I was coming out of my depression
extraits.texte: I'm not, but apparently this made me glow in a way that made it look like I had my life together. I didn't have the heart to tell her it was just skincare lol. Any time I use it, I get compliments on how my skin looks and I often pair it with the Ginzing eye cream. I personally think it smells really nice, but I will admit that it smells stronger than the typical Origins product (just smells like orange/citrus, nothing bad). I'll probably buy the full size when I finish my samples, and I encourage anyone to try it out if given the opportunity. I have sensitive, acne-prone skin so I tend not to use too much product on my skin daily, however I've never had a bad reaction with this. I use it maybe once or twice a week.

I'm coming from Kiehl's. Purchased this serum as one of my first Origins products to try it out. When I put this on after cleansing my face, it gave me an amazingly pleasant cooling sensation with a very nice citrusy smell. It did not leave any oily feels or anything. Some of the Kiehl's serums made for day time use definitely left my skin feeling oily, which I didn't like. I have combination skin. My moisturizer went onto this serum very nicely. I also like the fact that it comes in an actual glass bottle, not some cheap plastic bottle. This serum definitely has the WOW factor. Will continue to use it!

I've used this for about 3 months and my acne-prone super sensitive skin has brightened and cleared up so much! Ran out about 2 weeks ago and I can already see how dry and bumpy my skin is starting to look. Just purchased another bottle. I'll make sure to never run out again.

This serum is absolutely amazing. I love how fact acting it is. I noticed a change in my skins appearance after just one use. I've never experienced that type of performance from any other skincare product before. I would apply this serum every night and I would wake up to a brighter complexion. In the mornings, my skins texture would look so much more smoother and was more refined. My pores looked much less noticeable. The serum has a slight citrusy scent but it definitely fades away once applied. I look forward to plumper more hydrated skin since this serum is formulated with Hyaluronic Acid. With continue day and night use, I know my skin will develop a more radiant appeal. I have really dry and sensitive skin and I never experienced any irritation or discomfort after using this product. I'm definitely going to purchase this serum as soon as I run out. I've been enjoying this serum so much and seen very quick results that I've been recommending this skin care product to all my friends and family.
